select b.v as booking, s.v as status, eta.v as eta, sum(q.v) as units
from "sku/code" k
join "po_line/sku" pls on pls.v = k.e
join "shipment_line/po_line" slp on slp.v = pls.e
join "shipment_line/quantity" q on q.e = slp.e
join "core/part_of" part on part.e = slp.e
join "shipment/booking_no" b on b.e = part.v
join "shipment/status" s on s.e = b.e
left join "shipment/eta" eta on eta.e = b.e
where k.v = 'AH-KTL-0001-BLK' and s.v in ('departed','arrived')
group by b.v, s.v, eta.v
order by b.v

with first as (
  select distinct on (h.e) h.e, h.v as first_etd
  from history."po/etd" h
  where h.op = 'assert'
  order by h.e, h.tx
)
select n.v as po, f.first_etd, cur.v as current_etd
from "supplier/code" sc
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.v = sc.e
join "po/number" n on n.e = ps.e
join first f on f.e = ps.e
join "po/etd" cur on cur.e = ps.e
where sc.v = 'NBBW' and cur.v > f.first_etd
order by n.v

select b.v as booking, s.v as status, eta.v as eta
from "shipment/booking_no" b
join "shipment/status" s on s.e = b.e
left join "shipment/eta" eta on eta.e = b.e
where s.v in ('departed','arrived')
order by b.v

select count(*) entries, sum(ev.v) ev, sum(d.v) duty, sum(fe.v) fees
from "customs/entry_no" en
join "customs/filed_on" f on f.e = en.e
left join "customs/entered_value" ev on ev.e = en.e
left join "customs/duty" d on d.e = en.e
left join "customs/fees" fe on fe.e = en.e
where f.v between '2026-04-01' and '2026-06-30'

select sc.v as supplier, r.v as result, count(*) as n
from "qc/report_no" q
join "qc/inspected_on" d on d.e = q.e
join "qc/result" r on r.e = q.e
join "qc/po" qp on qp.e = q.e
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.e = qp.v
join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
where d.v >= '2026-01-01' and d.v <= '2026-12-31'
group by sc.v, r.v
order by sc.v, r.v

select k.v as sku, sv.v as variant, fn.v as fnsku, ss.v as seller_sku, t.v as tpl, fi.v as factory, sc.v as supplier
from "amazon/asin" a
join "sku/code" k on k.e = a.e
left join "shopify/variant_id" sv on sv.e = a.e
left join "amazon/fnsku" fn on fn.e = a.e
left join "amazon/seller_sku" ss on ss.e = a.e
left join "tpl/item_code" t on t.e = a.e
left join "factory/item_code" fi on fi.e = a.e
left join "sku/supplier" sp on sp.e = a.e
left join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = sp.v
where a.v = 'B0BVUGZ3AT'

select sc.v as supplier, pc.v as po_currency, sum(q.v * p.v) as value
from "po/number" po
join "po/status" st on st.e = po.e
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.e = po.e
join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
left join "core/currency" pc on pc.e = po.e
join "core/part_of" line on line.v = po.e
join "po_line/quantity" q on q.e = line.e
join "po_line/unit_price" p on p.e = line.e
where st.v not in ('shipped','received')
group by sc.v, pc.v
order by sc.v

with recursive
up(cur, depth) as (
  select c.e, 0 from "shopify/customer_id" c where c.v = '8995877069469'
  union all
  select s.v, up.depth+1 from up join "core/same_as" s on s.e = up.cur
),
root as (select cur as r from up order by depth desc limit 1),
grp(e) as (
  select r from root
  union all
  select s.e from grp join "core/same_as" s on s.v = grp.e
)
select (select count(*) from grp) as accounts,
       (select count(*) from "order/customer" oc join grp on grp.e = oc.v) as orders

select nm.v as actor, e.tx, at.v as at
from "po/number" po
join "po/etd" e on e.e = po.e
join "fs/at" at on at.e = e.tx
join "fs/actor" a on a.e = e.tx
join "fs/name" nm on nm.e = a.v
where po.v = 'PO-2026-0023'

select l.v as location_code, lk.v as kind, q.v as quantity
from "sku/code" k
join "inventory/sku" isk on isk.v = k.e
join "inventory/location" il on il.e = isk.e
join "location/code" l on l.e = il.v
join "location/kind" lk on lk.e = il.v
join "inventory/quantity" q on q.e = isk.e
where k.v = 'AH-TWL-0007-NAT' and lk.v in ('factory','in_transit')
order by l.v
